2e21dde48be974440193a00e7b6441e6a9ca1b9a.summary: Part 1 of an analysis of Panda Banker, a banking trojan that shares some code with the older Zeus malware. It injects code into web browsers to steal banking and card credentials, uses anti-analysis and obfuscation, and deletes itself when monitoring tools are detected. After execution it spawns a second binary. Part 1 covers initial memory analysis of that activity. Behavioural and reverse engineering are deferred to part 2. Published 2021-08-26 by Crovax.

2ea47ee3caf45c7eea548e479295854aa201d78b.summary: Encyclopedia article on booting: how a computer starts and loads its operating system, covering early hardware loaders, ROM and firmware, boot loaders, boot security and boot loops. It is not a threat report. It describes no threat actor, campaign, malware or vulnerability. The 2024 CrowdStrike update incident appears only as an example of a boot loop, not as a threat.

2e11ec83965d1af3d750cf20ddc8f8c3337220b1.summary: GReAT at Kaspersky describes Silence, a Trojan found in a targeted campaign against financial institutions, mostly Russian banks, with infections also found in Malaysia and Armenia. The attackers sent spear-phishing emails, often from addresses of employees of already infected banks, with a malicious help-file attachment. The payload is a set of Windows service modules that record victim screens, give console backconnect access, and can install further tools. The report says the attacks were still ongoing and that the group uses legitimate administration tools such as Winexesvc to avoid…

2e330f9e2f40c3c82b7a190fe66bbd9feaec173a.summary: Intezer researchers describe SysJoker, a C++ backdoor written separately for Windows, Linux and macOS. It was first found in an active attack on a Linux web server of an educational institution. It masquerades as a system update, gets its C2 address from a text file on Google Drive, and can run commands and drop executables. The report estimates the attack began in the second half of 2021 and assesses the operator as an advanced actor seeking espionage and lateral movement, possibly followed by ransomware. Published 11 January 2022.
